source_text:
10.5 ̔Ο δὲ ἀγαπῶν ἀδικίαν, μισεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ
ψυχήν. Εἰ ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὴν ἀδικίαν, μισεῖ τὴν ἑαυ τοῦ ψυχὴν, ὁ μισῶν δηλονότι τὴν
ἀδικίαν, ἀγαπᾷ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν.
pass_a_gloss: The and one-loving injustice, hates the of-himself soul. If the one-loving the injustice, hates the of-himself soul, the one-hating clearly the injustice, loves the of-himself soul.
pass_b_english: “And the one who loves injustice hates his own soul” (Psalm 10:5).
If the one who loves injustice hates his own soul, the one who hates injustice, clearly, loves his own soul.

choices.term: ὁ μισῶν δηλονότι τὴν ἀδικίαν, ἀγαπᾷ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν
choices.english: the one who hates injustice, clearly, loves his own soul
choices.why: Contraposition of the lemma, not a new command to hate people.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
